candidates.locator: Article I (1) — Of Faith In The Holy Trinity
candidates.phrase: the Maker, and Preserver of all things both visible and invisible
candidates.rationale: Article I explicitly calls God 'the Maker, and Preserver of all things both visible and invisible,' a direct confessional assertion of God's continued conservation of all creatures.
candidates.chunk_text: THERE is but one living and true God, ever- lasting, without body, parts, or passions; of infinite power, wisdom, and goodness; the Maker, and Preserver of all things both visible and invisible. And in unity of this Godhead there be three Persons, of one substance, power, and eternity; the Father, the Son, and the Holy Ghost.

candidates.phrase: a single loving God who creates, sustains, and directs it
candidates.rationale: The catechism states the universe is the work of one God 'who creates, sustains, and directs it,' directly asserting God's ongoing preservation of creation.
candidates.chunk_text: What does this mean? This means that the universe is good, that it is the work of a single loving God who creates, sustains, and directs it.
